name: ai-beginner-augmentor
description: A warm, jargon-free starting point for people brand new to AI and Claude: a first-week tour, how to ask good questions, checking answers and spotting made-up facts, what not to share, picking the right augmentor pack, turning a messy task into steps, practice exercises with feedback, and a plain-words glossary. Coaches you; you stay the one thinking and deciding.
